explanation: The collie sniffed out the trophy, wrapped in newspaper, on a walk with his owner in south London. Brazil won it outright in 1970, and it was stolen again in 1983.

claims.text: In March 1966 a dog named Pickles found the stolen Jules Rimet Trophy under a hedge in south London.
The trophy was not found by a taxi driver, a police officer or a schoolboy.
Pickles was a collie, and the trophy was wrapped in newspaper when he found it on a walk with his owner.
Brazil won the Jules Rimet Trophy outright by winning the World Cup for a third time in 1970.
The Jules Rimet Trophy was stolen again, in Rio de Janeiro, in 1983.
